from pydantic import model_validator
from omnibase_core.models.runtime.model_runtime_identity import ModelRuntimeIdentity
from omnibase_core.models.evidence_bundle.model_evidence_verifier_check import ModelEvidenceVerifierCheck


class ModelEvidenceVerifierResult(BaseModel):
    """Result produced by a verifier that checked an evidence bundle.

    ``checks`` is an ordered tuple of dicts — each dict records an individual
    check performed by the verifier (e.g. artifact presence, hash match,
    contract compliance). The ``verifier`` field names the agent or system
    that ran the checks.
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", from_attributes=True)

    correlation_id: str
    status: EnumReceiptStatus = EnumReceiptStatus.PASS
    verifier: ModelRuntimeIdentity
    checks: tuple[ModelEvidenceVerifierCheck, ...]

    @model_validator(mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def convert_checks_to_dicts(cls, data: dict) -> dict:
        if "checks" in data and isinstance(data["checks"], tuple):
            converted_checks = []
            for item in data["checks"]:
                if isinstance(item, ModelEvidenceVerifierCheck):
                    converted_checks.append(item.model_dump())
                else:
                    converted_checks.append(item)
            data["checks"] = tuple(converted_checks)
        return data
